theorems.name: Submission.cbr_smm_monotone_majorant
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (Z : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (a b : ℝ) (L : NNReal), (∀ j, Monotone (F j)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → Z j t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (F j t - F j (t - h))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → liminf (fun j => Z j t) atTop ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal (F j b - F j a)) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
